Definition: Dedan, the name of two Cushites and of their territory
BiblicalUsage: Dedan = "low country"; n pr m; 1) the son of Raamah and grandson of Cush. A son of Jokshan and grandson of Keturah; n pr loc; 2) a place in south Arabia
